title: events/types/task.transition
description: Payload for event_type 'task.transition' (native type, feature 007; UR-RUN-001..004): one ledger state-machine transition. The log of these events is the authoritative task record; the in-memory ledger and cursor are rebuildable.

from_state.description: null on the initial propose transition.

reason.description: Machine-stable reason code (e.g. effect_observed, lease_expired, attempts_exhausted, lock_conflict).

resources.description: Resource keys claimed/released with this transition.

lease_until.description: Game tick at which the lock lease expires (locked transitions).

spec.description: Full task spec persisted on the propose transition so a fresh ledger can rebuild and re-verify after restart.
